title: Survival skills
summary: Perfect Parry, Perfect Dodge, and the Blink / Repulse counters to special attacks.

sections.note: SP comes from first clears. A skill can be learned once the skill it requires is learned.
rows: Perfectly parries an enemy's attack and damages the enemy's Balance.
Makes it easier to use Perfect Parry.
Increases the amount of Beta Energy recharged upon a successful Perfect Parry.
Completely evades enemy attacks. A successful Perfect Dodge charges Burst Energy.
Makes it easier to use Perfect Dodge.
Recharges more Burst Energy upon a successful Perfect Dodge.

Can only be used when an enemy is attempting a fatal attack.
Dodges and teleports behind the enemy to attack. Charges Burst Energy upon landing a successful attack.
Swipe up to use this skill when the enemy attacks with a blue signal.

Can only be used when an enemy is attempting a fatal attack.
Pushes the enemy backward before backing up and knocks the enemy down if the attack lands.
Swipe down to use this skill when the enemy attacks with a purple signal.
Makes it easier to use Blink and Repulse.
Allows you to get up faster when downed.
Allows instant revival at the spot upon death in battles.
